fields.help_en:
The tag key used to precisely search for Elastic scaling resources. The tag key must be 1 to 128 characters in length.

Tags are used to precisely search for Elastic scaling resources bound with specific tags and consist of key-value pairs.
If only Tags.Key is specified, all resources associated with the tag key are returned.
If only Tags.Value is specified, a MissingParameter.TagKey error is reported.
If multiple tag key-value pairs are specified, only Elastic scaling resources that meet all the tag key-value pairs are found
fields.help_zh:
精确查找弹性伸缩资源时使用的标签键。标签键长度的取值范围：1~128。

`Tags`用于精确查找绑定了指定标签的弹性伸缩资源，由一个键值对组成。
仅指定`Tags.Key`时，则返回关联该标签键的所有资源。
仅指定`Tags.Value`时，则出现`MissingParameter.TagKey`的报错提示。
同时指定多个标签键值对时，仅同时满足所有标签键值对的弹性伸缩资源会被查找到
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. This parameter is optional and can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, cannot start with acs:, and cannot contain http:// or https://

DOD_UP: Day-on-day increase percentage.
DOD_DOWN: Day-on-day decrease percentage

PREVIOUS_DOWN：环比下降百分比
HOH_UP：与上小时同比上升百分比
HOH_DOWN：与上小时同比下降百分比
DOD_UP：与昨日同比上升百分比
DOD_DOWN：与昨日同比下降百分比

Config.description_en:
The configuration items of the alert rule, in JSON string format.

Valid values of continuous:

true: Send alert notifications every minute.
false: Enable the alert silence period switch.

dataRevision indicates the data revision policy when no data is obtained or the data is null. Valid values:
  
0: Zero filling policy.
1: Fill with 1 policy.
2: Fill with null (default). The data is not processed, and no alert event is generated when there is no data
Config.description_zh:
报警规则的配置项，格式为JSON字符串。

continuous的值包括：

`true`：每分钟均发送报警
`false`：打开报警静默期开关

dataRevision表示未取得数据或者或数据为null值时的数据修订策略，包括：
  
`0`：补零策略。
`1`：补一策略。
`2`：补null （默认补null），将不对数据做处理，无数据时将不会生成报警事件

Dimensions.description_en: The dimension conditions in the alert rule judgment conditions
Dimensions.description_zh: 报警规则判断条件中的维度条件

Key.description_en:
The dimension name. Valid values:

rpc: API name.
rpcType: API call type, such as HTTP or DUBBO.
endpoint: Database name.
rootIp: Machine IP address
Key.description_zh:
维度名称，包括以下值：

`rpc`：接口名称
`rpcType`：接口调用类型（如HTTP、DUBBO）
`endpoint`：数据库名称
`rootIp`：机器IP地址

Type.description_en:
The type of the dimension condition. Valid values:

STATIC: To match a fixed dimension value, you must specify dimensions.value.
ALL: Traverse all dimension values and judge sequentially based on the metrics of all API names. The API name that triggers the threshold will be reflected in the alert content. In this case, dimensions.value is not required.
DISABLE: Aggregate all dimension values into a single value (sum). In this case, dimensions.value is not required
Type.description_zh:
维度条件的类型，包含以下可选值：

`STATIC`： 固定匹配此维度值需要填dimensions.value。
`ALL`：遍历所有维度值，按此接口所有接口名的指标依次判断，哪个接口触发阈值引起报警，就会在报警内容中体现该接口名，此时不需要填dimensions.value。
`DISABLE`：聚合所有维度值为一个值（求和），此时不需要填dimensions.value

Value.description_en: The value of the dimension option
